question: Where’s the closest fast food restaurant you hit on the way to Green rooftop garden at design building, Amherst, MA from Sonny's Place, Somers, CT?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Sonny''s Place%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Somers%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CT%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Green rooftop garden at design building%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Amherst%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, start_point AS sp, end_point AS ep WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' AND sp.geometry IS NOT NULL AND ep.geometry IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ST_Distance(sp.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) + ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, ep.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
